original.reason: The forward proof incorrectly infers H=<x^k> is strictly contained in <x^p> merely because p is a proper divisor of k. With exponents considered modulo the group order this need not be strict; e.g. n=6, k=4, p=2 gives <x^4>=<x^2>. Thus its contradiction argument has a material gap, although the theorem itself is correct.
